missing_capability_rules: If selected lane needs Go and go_version is missing, report GO_TOOLCHAIN_MISSING.
If selected lane needs C++/CMake and cmake_version is missing, report CPP_CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_MISSING.
If task asks for game engine and no engine record exists, report GAME_ENGINE_CAPABILITY_NOT_INVENTORIED.
If task asks for strict build and build lane was not run, report STRICT_BUILD_LANE_REQUIRED.
If task asks for UI reference fidelity and no reference proof exists, report UI_REFERENCE_FIDELITY_TOOLING_REQUIRED.
